question: Which type of ritual implement is preferred when both new and old options exist?
premises: A new implement is considered best.
An old implement is an alternative.
The old implement is used only in the absence of a new one.
inference: A newly made implement is preferred, and an old one may be used only if a new one is unavailable.
plain_english: A new implement is best; an old one may be used only if a new one is not available.
